Do not invent sounds or name a song/composer from contextual guesses. Omit routine narration and generic 'male voice speaking'. Keep only clearly heard observations, at most 6 events. No precise event timestamps: this entire clip is a coarse review interval. For vocal-delivery events, report distinctive deviations or changes, not the narrator's routine baseline voice. Describe unusual pronunciation or foreign-language words only with actually heard syllables/features; do not assume correctness from a person's identity or from written spellings.
Across the collection we are also looking for possible Chinese anthem 'March of the Volunteers' (义勇军进行曲), distinct from North Korea's anthem 'Aegukka'. Only if the audible melody, lyrics or instrumentation actually supports a candidate, describe those heard features and label the identity UNCONFIRMED CANDIDATE. Do not treat a march or brass alone as proof, do not assert exact song/composer/catalogue identity.
